data: Microsoft's operating income rose from $88,523 million in fiscal 2023 (the year ended June 30, 2023) to $128,528 million in fiscal 2025 (the year ended June 30, 2025), according to the income statement in its fiscal 2025 Form 10-K. That is an increase of $40,005 million, or about 45.2% over the two years. Revenue grew more slowly over the same period, from $211,915 million to $281,724 million (about 32.9%), so operating margin widened from roughly 41.8% to 45.6%. Fiscal 2024 operating income of $109,433 million sat between the two years.
